metadata.title: Groupicorn Connecticut IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This September 23, 2026 New Haven / Milford / Shoreline pass verifies current official IOP/PHP evidence for local provider sites and adds tracked PNG assets where an official provider-controlled image was available. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings; remaining leads stay queued when an evidence or asset gate is incomplete.
metadata.branding_note: Newly verified records use tracked PNG assets acquired from official provider-controlled sources. Legacy Connecticut fragments retain their original provenance and require separate asset migration before publication.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.
